The Procter & Gamble Company (the Company) is a world-leading multinational consumer goods company focused on providing trusted, branded products of superior quality, performance and value to improve the lives of consumers around the world - now and for generations to come. Our products are sold in about 180 countries and territories throughout the world. The Company was incorporated in Ohio in 1905, having first been established as a New Jersey corporation in 1890, and was built from a business founded in Cincinnati in 1837 by William Procter and James Gamble. credit_strengths.text: Operating margin is well above the consumer staples sector median, reflecting the pricing power of a broad portfolio of leading household and personal care brands sold across many markets. Profitability at this level funds internal investment and distributions without straining the balance sheet.

Gross and net leverage both sit comfortably below sector medians, and net leverage is well inside the next risk-band boundary. The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, giving substantial headroom for debt-funded distributions or bolt-on acquisitions without a material change in credit quality.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows a large current maturity wall plus commercial paper outstanding, so refinancing is a recurring, sizeable task. Management must roll short-dated paper and term debt in credit markets that the risk factors flag as potentially disrupted, which could raise funding costs or force a draw on liquidity.

Disclosed risks include foreign currency and interest rate volatility, tariffs and trade controls, and supply chain concentration in sole-supplier arrangements. These could pressure margins and cash conversion, and the operating margin already eased year over year, so earnings durability is the main sensitivity for leverage.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is far above the sector median and broadly stable year over year, with operating income dwarfing gross interest expense. Even a sharp earnings decline would leave ample cushion, so debt service is not a near-term constraint on the credit.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure and dividends with room to spare, and free cash flow covers dividends comfortably. However, free cash flow falls short of total dividends plus buybacks, so shareholder returns are partly funded from balance sheet capacity rather than internally generated cash alone.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile: leverage below sector medians, strong cash flow relative to debt, and very high coverage. Cash and equivalents provide a meaningful buffer against the current maturity wall, though the cash figure includes restricted balances and may overstate freely available liquidity.

Our judgement is that credit quality is anchored by stable demand for branded consumer staples and robust cash generation, offset by heavy shareholder distributions and refinancing needs. The current ratio below one and below the sector median reflects a working-capital-light model rather than distress, but liquidity management warrants monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: 營運利潤率遠高於消費必需品行業中位數，反映旗下眾多市場銷售的領先家庭及個人護理品牌組合的定價能力。此水平的盈利能力可為內部投資及分派提供資金，而不會對資產負債表構成壓力。
總槓桿及淨槓桿均穩居行業中位數以下，而淨槓桿更遠低於下一個風險區間邊界。指示性財務風險狀況為極低，為債務融資分派或補強型收購提供充裕空間，而不會導致信貸質素出現重大變化。

key_risks.text: 債務附註顯示存在龐大的即期到期債務牆，加上未償還商業票據，故再融資是一項經常性且規模龐大的任務。管理層須在風險因素標示為可能受干擾的信貸市場中滾動短期票據及定期債務，此舉可能推高融資成本或迫使動用流動性。
披露風險包括外匯及利率波動、關稅及貿易管制，以及獨家供應商安排下的供應鏈集中度。這些因素可能對利潤率及現金轉換構成壓力，而營運利潤率已按年放緩，故盈利持久性是槓桿的主要敏感因素。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，並按年大致穩定，經營收入遠超總利息支出。即使盈利大幅下滑，仍會留有充裕緩衝，故債務償付並非短期內對信貸的制約。
經營現金流覆蓋資本開支及股息後仍有餘裕，而自由現金流則穩健覆蓋股息。然而，自由現金流低於股息加回購總額，故股東回報部分由資產負債表能力而非僅內部產生現金所支持。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈極低的指示性財務風險狀況：槓桿低於行業中位數、現金流相對債務強勁，以及覆蓋率極高。現金及等價物為即期到期債務牆提供有意義的緩衝，惟現金數字包括受限制結餘，可能高估可自由動用的流動性。
我們的判斷是，信貸質素以品牌消費必需品的穩定需求及強勁現金產生能力為錨，並由沉重的股東分派及再融資需求所抵銷。流動比率低於一及低於行業中位數，反映營運資金輕型的模式而非困境，惟流動性管理值得監察。
